chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqteen, from his brother Al-Husayn, from Ali ibn Yaqteen, from Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him)
Regarding the man who urinates but forgets to wash his penis, then he performs the ablution for the prayer: He said: He should wash his penis; he repeats the prayer and does not repeat the ablution.

key_terms.وَلَا يُعِيدُ الْوُضُوءَ: and does not repeat the ablution

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if one forgets to wash the penis after urination before praying?
ai.summary: In this ruling from al-Kafi, Imam al-Rida (AS) clarifies the distinction between the essential purification of the private part (ghasl al-dhakara) and the ritual ablution (wudu), establishing that forgetting the former invalidates the prayer's validity but not the state of wudu itself. This highlights the Shia jurisprudential view that ghasl al-dhakara is a prerequisite condition for the acceptance of prayer rather than a pillar of wudu, allowing the believer to maintain their ritual state while correcting the specific omission. The hadith underscores the precision required in minor purification acts, ensuring that the physical cleanliness necessary for standing before God is fully realized before the prayer commences.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Bin Yaqteen, from his brother Al Husayn, from Ali Bin Yaqteen, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>

regarding the man who urinates but he forgets to wash his manhood. Then he performs Ablution (Wudhu) for the Salaat. Heasws said: ‘He should wash his manhood. He would repeat the Salaat and he would not repeat the Ablution (Wudhu)’.
en.sarwar: 15. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from al-Hassan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin from his brother, Al- Husayn, from Ali ibn Yaqtin who has said the following: “I once asked abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,

about a man who forgets to wash clean his urethra but he takes Wudu’ and performs Salah (prayer). He (the Imam) said, ’He must wash his urethra clean and perform his Salah (prayer) again, but he does not have to take Wudu’ again.’” H 3872, Ch. 12, h 16
